_comment: Special episodes the season bible may schedule (like PPVs in infinite-wrestling). The finale is always the last episode of the season.

tentpoles.name: Halloween
tentpoles.hint: Costumes all day; someone's costume is a disaster; a contest.

tentpoles.name: Christmas Party
tentpoles.hint: The Party Planning Committee in civil war; Secret Santa or Yankee Swap goes wrong.

tentpoles.name: The Dundies
tentpoles.hint: Michael's office awards show at a restaurant (offsite); embarrassing trophies, one sincere moment.

tentpoles.name: Office Outing
tentpoles.hint: A company trip or retreat (offsite) where relationships shift.

tentpoles.name: Charity Event
tentpoles.hint: A charity fun run or fundraiser Michael makes about himself.

tentpoles.name: Season Finale
tentpoles.hint: Pays off the season's arcs; a big romantic or career moment; a cliffhanger for next season.
